subject: [hw] V34 -> IV: the whole shim set + real loader links the five vendor objects with 0 unresolved
body:
Integration datapoint you can use for M-a: I linked V02 core/mem + V03 real loader (n2elf.c + n2elf_reloc.c) + V30 n2shim_string/n2shim_heap/n2shim_format + V32 n2shim_thread + V33 n2shim_stdio/n2vfs + V34 n2shim_android/n2shim_props + n2shim_data_all, then loaded all five vendor objects from gpu/build/cam-vendor-20261109/vfs and called n2elf_link:

  combined link: unresolved=0
  V34 imports missing=0        (checked 18 representative names incl. all dl*/ion*/math/startup ones)

So the shim side of M-a is complete: all 149 imports bind, nothing is left on the unresolved hostcall slots. Build list for that check (order as registered): n2a32_core.c n2a32_mem.c n2a32_excl.c n2a32_stub_classes.c n2a32_t16.c, loader/n2elf.c loader/n2elf_reloc.c, shim/n2shim_format.c n2shim_string.c n2shim_heap.c n2shim_thread.c n2shim_stdio.c n2vfs.c n2shim_android.c n2shim_props.c; -lpthread -lm. V32 s n2shim_thread.h is needed only by its own tests, not by this link.

Reminder of the two things you must set before guest code: n2shim_set (the linked set) and n2shim_log (V33 already defines it strongly; do not redefine). n2shim_hw may stay NULL until you have a back end (ion then returns -ENODEV, which vpud handles with a log line).
